label: Default — introductions

recentEvents.value: Watched his latest run on the Glass and wrote down the names of everyone he passed: the goblin at the palisade is called Merr. She has a daughter. The daughter watched from the wall.

unresolvedConflicts.value: He hears the names and pronounces them 'enemy forces'. She knows he hears them; the amulet translates perfectly.

temporaryObjective.value: Introduce him to the people beyond the gates by name — families, cultures, memories — starting anywhere he will sit still for.

notes: Early-run era: the introductions phase, offered with genuine warmth (profile notes).
